_note: GM ONLY. Never loaded into the narrator's context — court orthodoxies are honest about what the court collectively knows, which makes this file vault-adjacent. Resolved beliefs feed the GM's turn block only; they reach the narrator solely as the GM voices them through npc_direction. Tier-1 of the belief stack: resolution order is ledger -> seed_beliefs (private card) -> faction chain, nearest first -> miss (generate-and-commit). Orthodoxies do not bind their author: miranda is parentless because she wrote both faiths. Membership lists name the most specific faction only; parents are implied. default_member_of makes the resolver total over unnamed villagers.
